summary: STMicroelectronics filed a Form 6-K under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, reporting periodic share repurchases under its existing buy-back program approved by shareholders on May 22, 2024. The registrant repurchased 396,468 shares (0.04% of issued capital) between August 18-21, 2026, at a weighted average price of EUR 44.4019 per share, totaling EUR 17,603,932.09. These buybacks are routine capital-return activities, not a special situation. The filing discloses treasury holdings and repurchase details. No transaction with special-situations characteristics such as a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring is present. What to watch: continued execution of the program and treasury balance changes.
